disclosure: Each stop on each axis is a real run of plumbline.allocate over a manifest with one field changed. The witness is the engine's; the verification is this browser's. Signatures are HMAC under prototype keys, and no signature survives a perturbation.

criterion: maximise witness-backed value on this cart; break ties by lower asserted value, then by instrument id
method: one field of one benefit is changed; plumbline.allocate is re-run over the same cart; the witness it produced is carried here and re-checked in the browser against a manifest the console perturbs for itself

instruments.source: publicly published card terms as at 2026-07-27, modelled; remaining balances are SYNTHETIC member state, not live issuer data

benefits.label: 1 Membership Rewards point for every ₹40 spent
benefits.note: 1 MR per ₹40 at ₹0.25 per point is 0.62% and rounds down to 62 bp. Eligibility is an allow-list because the published terms exclude fuel, insurance, utilities, cash_transaction, emi_conversion; fuel is excluded here and carries its own published rate below

benefits.label: 3X Membership Rewards points on spend incurred abroad
benefits.note: shares an exclusivity group with the base rate: 3X replaces 1X and is never added to it. Overseas-ness is carried on the cart line, so the manifest declares no condition its own vocabulary cannot express

benefits.label: 5 Membership Rewards points for every ₹100 spent on fuel
benefits.note: published cap is 5,000 Membership Rewards Points per calendar month, carried here as value headroom. SYNTHETIC member state: 2,000 points already drawn, leaving ₹750. An earn benefit is never applied fractionally, so a fuel line whose earn exceeds the headroom is dropped rather than clipped, which understates

benefits.label: Taj Epicure Plus membership
benefits.note: declared and considered, deliberately not scored, and stated precisely because it is the term this card is most often misquoted on: Taj Epicure Plus is a MEMBERSHIP the Cardmember enrols into, not a rupee credit. It delivers percentage privileges — 25% off food and beverage at participating Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta, Gateway and Claridges hotels, 25% off Qmin delivery, 20% off Jiva Spa treatments. American Express publishes no rupee value for it, so this manifest asserts none

benefits.label: 25% off dining on District by Zomato, Wednesdays
benefits.note: declared and considered, deliberately not scored: the published offer is 25% off up to ₹5,000 per transaction and ₹10,000 per calendar month, but it requires a coupon code, runs only on one weekday and is time-boxed to a promo window. This manifest's vocabulary can express none of those three conditions, and a benefit priced without the conditions that gate it would overstate

benefits.label: 1,550+ airport lounges worldwide, including The Centurion Lounge, Delta Sky Club and Priority Pass
benefits.note: declared and considered, deliberately not scored: service, access and status are real value that no integer on this receipt claims to capture

benefits.note: declared and considered, deliberately not scored: both turn on a spend total over a membership period, and no allocation on one cart can realize them

benefits.label: Rewards Xcelerator, up to 20X Membership Rewards at partner brands

benefits.label: 5 Reward Points per ₹150 of eligible retail spend
benefits.note: 5 RP per ₹150 at 1 RP = ₹1 on SmartBuy travel redemption is 3.33% and rounds down to 333 bp. Points accrue in whole ₹150 blocks, which a linear rate cannot express; the modelled rate can exceed the block-rounded figure by strictly less than 5 RP on one line. Eligibility is an allow-list because the published terms pay nothing on wallet_load, fuel, rent, government, emi_conversion

benefits.label: 10X Reward Points on hotels booked through SmartBuy
benefits.note: 10X of the 5 RP per ₹150 base is 50 RP per ₹150, which rounds down to 3333 bp. The published cap is 15,000 accelerated Reward Points per calendar month, shared across SmartBuy categories. SYNTHETIC member state: 5,800 already drawn, leaving ₹9,200

benefits.label: 5X Reward Points on flights booked through SmartBuy
benefits.note: 5X of the base is 25 RP per ₹150, which rounds down to 1666 bp. Declared with zero headroom because the monthly accelerated pool is SHARED with the hotel accelerator and is carried there in full: giving each accelerator its own copy of one pool would let a cart spend it twice

instruments.source: HYPOTHETICAL INSTRUMENT — invented for this demonstration. Not a real product, not modelled from any issuer's published terms, and signed by no one. It is in the candidate set because the published Indian catalogue carries no statement credits, so the case where two credits compete for one line cannot be shown from real Indian terms; attaching invented credits to a real issuer's product name is the one thing this system may never do.

axes.benefit_note: invented figure on a hypothetical instrument; no issuer publishes this; ₹500 of balance against a much larger room charge
axes.label: Annual stay credit · balance remaining
axes.what_it_is: how much of this account's stay credit is left today. Two Card Members hold the same product with different balances, so moving this asserts nothing about the product's terms.
axes.watch_for: the balance lands whole on the first stay it admits and the second stay gets nothing, because the two share an exclusivity group. That is the shortfall no per-line implementation can see: it is not a property of either line alone.

axes.benefit_note: invented figure on a hypothetical instrument; no issuer publishes this; ₹300 of balance against a larger dinner
axes.label: Monthly dining credit · balance remaining
axes.what_it_is: how much of this month's dining credit is left. Member state again, and the only knob on this screen whose movement changes WHICH benefit wins a line.
axes.watch_for: below ₹200 the enrolled partner credit takes the dinner instead and this one leaves the derivation entirely. At exactly ₹200 the tie breaks on benefit id and never on iteration order, which is why two runs produce the same receipt.

axes.benefit_note: invented figure on a hypothetical instrument; no issuer publishes this; the shared annual headroom is drawn down across lines
axes.label: Travel multiplier · annual cap headroom
axes.what_it_is: how much of the annual multiplier cap this account has not yet used. Member state, not a published rate.
axes.watch_for: a multiplier is all-or-nothing under this manifest — no partial rate is declared — so a line contributes nothing until the headroom covers it whole, and then the base rate in the same group stops applying to that line.

axes.benefit_label: 5 Membership Rewards points for every ₹100 spent on fuel
axes.benefit_note: published cap is 5,000 Membership Rewards Points per calendar month, carried here as value headroom. SYNTHETIC member state: 2,000 points already drawn, leaving ₹750. An earn benefit is never applied fractionally, so a fuel line whose earn exceeds the headroom is dropped rather than clipped, which understates
axes.label: Fuel earn · monthly cap headroom
axes.what_it_is: how much of the published 5,000 Membership Rewards Points a calendar month this account has not yet drawn on fuel. It is member state, which is the only kind of knob this screen puts on a real issuer's product: a balance differs between two holders of the same card, a rate does not.
axes.watch_for: the fuel line is the one place on this cart where the published Amex rate is the only rate standing — every other instrument in the candidate set excludes fuel from its base earn. The line earns ₹60 and an earn benefit is never applied fractionally, so the two stops either side of ₹60 turn it on and off whole: below that the line is dropped rather than clipped, which understates, and understating is the safe direction.

axes.benefit_note: invented figure on a hypothetical instrument; no issuer publishes this; shares an exclusivity group with the travel multiplier, because a bonus rate replaces a base rate and never adds to it
axes.label: Illustrative Reserve base earn · rate
axes.what_it_is: a rate, and therefore a product term rather than member state. It is moved only here, on the one instrument in the candidate set that is invented outright and signed by nobody, because a rate printed beside a real product's name is a claim about that product and we do not make it.
axes.watch_for: the only axis that moves a rate. Every line it admits re-values at once and the ranking moves with it, while the travel multiplier's own headroom holds the total down at the top end.
